title: zap.sh is not dealing with ~/.ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties correctly
body:
Hello,
current zap.sh (ZAP 2.4.2) is not dealing correctly with the "~" expansion of the ~/.ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties . Instead of expanding the "~" it is used as literal and the directory is never found. As a result the memory setting there is never honored.

Instead of 

```
if [ "$OS" = "Darwin" ]; then
  JVMPROPS="~/Library/Application Support/ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties"
else
  JVMPROPS="~/.ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties"
fi
```

There should be 

```
if [ "$OS" = "Darwin" ]; then
  JVMPROPS=~/Library/Application\ Support/ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties
else
  JVMPROPS=~/.ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties
fi
```

As the content of the file/variable will be something like -Xmx1024m the variable should be also properly quoted in the subsequent "if" statements and the java call itself - here is whole diff:

```
$ diff -ru /opt/zap/ZAP_2.4.2/zap.sh.orig /opt/zap/ZAP_2.4.2/zap.sh
--- /opt/zap/ZAP_2.4.2/zap.sh.orig  2015-09-21 16:56:44.000000000 +0200
+++ /opt/zap/ZAP_2.4.2/zap.sh   2015-09-26 01:58:44.920064467 +0200
@@ -54,15 +54,15 @@
 fi

 if [ "$OS" = "Darwin" ]; then
-  JVMPROPS="~/Library/Application Support/ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties"
+  JVMPROPS=~/Library/Application\ Support/ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties
 else
-  JVMPROPS="~/.ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties"
+  JVMPROPS=~/.ZAP/.ZAP_JVM.properties
 fi

 # Work out best memory options
-if [ -f $JVMPROPS ]; then
+if [ -f "$JVMPROPS" ]; then
   # Local jvm properties file present
-  JMEM=$(head -1 $JVMPROPS)
+  JMEM=$(head -1 "$JVMPROPS" )
 elif [ "$OS" = "Linux" ]; then
   MEM=$(expr $(sed -n 's/MemTotal:[ ]\{1,\}\([0-9]\{1,\}\) kB/\1/p' /proc/meminfo) / 1024)
 elif [ "$OS" = "Darwin" ]; then
@@ -73,21 +73,21 @@
   MEM=$(($(sysctl -n hw.physmem)/1024/1024))
 fi

-if [ ! -z $JMEM ]; then
+if [ ! -z "$JMEM" ]; then
   echo "Using jvm memory setting from " ~/.ZAP_JVM.properties
-elif [ -z $MEM ]; then
+elif [ -z "$MEM" ]; then
   echo "Failed to obtain current memory, using jvm default memory settings"
 else
-  echo "Available memory: " $MEM "MB"
-  if [ $MEM -gt 1500 ]
+  echo "Available memory: " "$MEM" "MB"
+  if [ "$MEM" -gt 1500 ]
   then
     JMEM="-Xmx512m"
   else
-    if [ $MEM -gt 900 ]
+    if [ "$MEM" -gt 900 ]
     then
       JMEM="-Xmx256m"
     else
-      if [ $MEM -gt 512 ]
+      if [ "$MEM" -gt 512 ]
       then
         JMEM="-Xmx128m"
       fi
@@ -110,7 +110,8 @@
   done

   # It's likely that -Xdock:icon would be ignored on other platforms, but this is known to work
-  exec java ${JMEM} -Xdock:icon="../Resources/ZAP.icns" -jar "${BASEDIR}/zap-D-2015-09-21.jar" "${ZAP_ARGS[@]}"
+  exec java "${JMEM}" -Xdock:icon="../Resources/ZAP.icns" -jar "${BASEDIR}/zap-2.4.2.jar" "${ZAP_ARGS[@]}"
 else
-  exec java ${JMEM} -jar "${BASEDIR}/zap-D-2015-09-21.jar" "$@"
+  exec java "${JMEM}" -jar "${BASEDIR}/zap-2.4.2.jar" "$@"
 fi
+
```
